payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over internal elements, counting those where (a[i]-a[i-1])*(a[i]-a[i+1]) > 0 indicates a local extremum.
payload.rationale: The solution simply iterates and checks a condition; no combinatorial search. Among the given complete_search subtypes, search_backtracking is the most generic name, though no backtracking occurs. Very low confidence.
